definitions: A technology that superimposes a computer-generated image on a user's view of the real world, thus providing a composite view.

An interactive experience of a real-world environment where the objects that reside in the real world are 'augmented' by computer-generated perceptual information, sometimes across multiple sensory modalities, including visual, auditory, haptic, somatosensory, and olfactory.
examples: Many apps now use augmented reality.
Augmented reality can enhance learning experiences.
The new game features impressive augmented reality.
